purpose: Statement of Claim — the small-claims equivalent of a complaint. If the claim is based on a written document (the policy), a copy must be attached.
Summons / Notice to Appear for Pretrial Conference — notifies the defendant to appear in small claims court. Issued by the clerk.
Pretrial Conference Order and Notice of Trial — issued by the court, not the filer.
Complaint (general model) — the pleading that states the parties, the facts, the breach, and the relief sought for county or circuit civil cases.
Civil Cover Sheet — required for cases over $8,000 in county or circuit civil court. Reports data to the clerk under § 25.075.
Summons — commands the defendant to respond in county or circuit civil cases. Issued by the clerk.

form_no: Application for Determination of Civil Indigent Status
purpose: Requests a waiver of filing and service fees for those who qualify financially.
Notice of Intent to Initiate Litigation under § 627.70152 — the mandatory pre-suit filing with DFS. Must be filed through the DFS online portal at least 10 business days before filing suit.
Civil Remedy Notice of Insurer Violation — required before any statutory bad-faith suit under § 624.155. Must be filed with DFS on the DFS-provided form, giving the insurer 60 days to cure.
Request for state-administered residential property mediation under § 627.7015. Filed through the DFS Division of Consumer Services. Insurer bears the $350 cost.
